question:
Study the given diagram carefully and answer the question. The numbers in different sections indicate the number of things.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/84abcf6c5a5c5ca5d41e0d6919e030084cf94c484f714846d44f76c72a33dfb9.png] 

How many such walkers are there that are also highchairs but NEITHER prams NOR strollers?
solution:
The region that best represents the number of walkers which are also highchairs but NEITHER prams NOR strollers:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cabdc2d1cd2e9ee1793102309aed5ff185e00c526c1ccf9611993795b0f04bff.png] 

Here, the marked area shows the number of walkers which are also highchairs but NEITHER prams NOR strollers.

So, the number of walkers which are also highchairs but NEITHER prams NOR strollers ⇒ 5

Hence, "Option 1" is the correct answer.
